title: Acupoint injection and electrical stimulation for postoperative nausea and vomiting: A randomized clinical trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: Randomized four-arm gynecologic laparoscopy trial includes a TEAS-only arm and a non-stimulation control with clinical PONV outcomes.
concise_private_rationale: The independent TEAS effect is estimable and perioperative general anaesthesia is strongly supported by the operation.

title: Electroacupuncture for recovery of gastrointestinal function after laparoscopic hysterectomy surgery: a prospective, randomized, controlled trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: Randomized EA versus control beginning 3–5 hours after laparoscopic hysterectomy with gastrointestinal recovery and pain outcomes.
concise_private_rationale: Eligible needle EA, timing, comparison, and clinical perioperative outcomes are clearly supported.

title: A Randomized, Sham-Controlled Trial on the Efficacy and Safety of Electroacupuncture for Lumbar Disc Herniation with Radiculopathy: Rationale and Study Protocol.
evidence_supporting_decision: Title and abstract identify a randomized trial protocol for lumbar disc herniation and describe planned methods without results.
concise_private_rationale: Protocol without participant outcome results.

title: Clinical Study on the Application of Acupuncture in the Postoperative Rehabilitation of Dogs Affected by Acute Thoracolumbar Disc Herniation.
evidence_supporting_decision: The study population is dogs undergoing surgery and postoperative rehabilitation.
concise_private_rationale: Non-human study.

title: Electroacupuncture in the treatment of gastrointestinal dysfunction after laparoscopic nephrectomy: a retrospective analysis.
evidence_supporting_decision: The abstract explicitly describes a retrospective medical-record analysis after laparoscopic nephrectomy.
concise_private_rationale: Retrospective observational study rather than an RCT.

title: Efficacy and safety of transcutaneous electrical acupoint stimulation for preoperative anxiety in thoracoscopic surgery: a randomized controlled trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: Randomized TEAS versus sham beginning before surgery in video-assisted thoracic surgery with clinical postoperative outcomes.
concise_private_rationale: Eligible perioperative TEAS and sham comparison; general anaesthesia is strongly supported by VATS.

title: Effectiveness of P6 Stimulation and Transdermal Scopolamine Patch for the Reduction of Nausea and Vomiting During Caesarean Section Under Combined Spinal-Epidural Anesthesia: A Randomized Clinical Trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: Cesarean delivery is explicitly performed under combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
concise_private_rationale: The operative anaesthetic is neuraxial without general anaesthesia.

title: Randomized Trial on Electroacupuncture for Recovery of Postoperative Gastrointestinal Function Based on Long-Term Monitoring Device.
evidence_supporting_decision: Randomized EA versus sham delivered two hours after gastric cancer surgery with gastrointestinal recovery outcomes.
concise_private_rationale: Eligible needle EA, sham comparison, timing, and clinical outcomes are supported; general anaesthesia is highly plausible.

title: Risk of Postoperative Nausea and Vomiting After Total Hip or Knee Arthroplasty Under Spinal Anesthesia: Randomized Trial Comparing Conventional Antiemetics with or without the EmeTerm Bracelet.
evidence_supporting_decision: Total hip or knee arthroplasty is explicitly conducted under spinal anesthesia.
concise_private_rationale: The operative anaesthetic is spinal without general anaesthesia.

title: Electroacupuncture for acute postoperative pain during coughing after video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery: study protocol for a pilot randomized controlled trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: The report is a pilot-study protocol for perioperative EA in video-assisted thoracic surgery.
concise_private_rationale: Protocol without participant outcome results.

title: Umbilical acupuncture combined with warm needle acupuncture for the treatment of residual numbness after lumbar disc herniation surgery: a protocol of a randomized controlled trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: The report describes a planned trial of warm needling plus acupuncture versus EA for residual symptoms after lumbar disc surgery.
concise_private_rationale: Protocol without participant outcome results.

title: Effect of single or multi-period use of transcutaneous acupoint electrical stimulation on postoperative nausea and vomiting in patients undergoing gynecological laparoscopic surgery: a prospective randomized double-blind trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: Randomized gynecologic laparoscopy trial compares perioperative TEAS timing groups with a non-stimulation control and reports PONV.
concise_private_rationale: Eligible TEAS, independent comparison, and clinical perioperative results are supported.

title: Timing of transcutaneous acupoint electrical stimulation for postoperative recovery in geriatric patients with gastrointestinal tumors: study protocol for a randomized controlled trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: The report is a protocol evaluating TEAS timing in older patients undergoing gastrointestinal tumor resection.
concise_private_rationale: Protocol without participant outcome results.

title: Safety and Effectiveness of Electroacupuncture During Colon Endoscopic Submucosal Dissection: A Randomized Controlled Trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: Colon endoscopic submucosal dissection is described as painless endoscopy with propofol sedation.
concise_private_rationale: The procedure is performed with sedation rather than general anaesthesia.

title: [Effect of transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation combined with patient-controlled intravenous analgesia on postoperative pain in patients with total knee arthroplasty].
evidence_supporting_decision: The intervention is transcutaneous auricular vagus nerve stimulation after total knee arthroplasty.
concise_private_rationale: Auricular stimulation is outside the eligible body-acupoint TEAS definition.

title: Effects of non-pharmacological interventions on anxiety in patients undergoing colonoscopy: A network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
evidence_supporting_decision: The title and abstract identify a network meta-analysis rather than a primary randomized trial report.

title: Effect of electroacupuncture on the incidence of acute stroke after embolisation of intracranial aneurysm: study protocol for a single-centre, double-blinded, randomised controlled trial.

title: Electroacupuncture Reduces Duration of Postoperative Ileus After Laparoscopic Gastrectomy for Gastric Cancer: A Multicenter Randomized Trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: Multicenter randomized EA versus sham versus standard-care trial after laparoscopic gastrectomy reports gastrointestinal recovery outcomes.

title: [Clinical study on transcutaneous electrical acupoint stimulation combined with skin sympathetic response to evaluate autonomic nerve preservation after laparoscopic radical gastrectomy].
evidence_supporting_decision: The abstract explicitly identifies a retrospective cohort study.

title: Does perioperative electroacupuncture reduce postoperative pain in dogs undergoing ovariohysterectomy?

evidence_supporting_decision: The report is a protocol for an EA trial in colorectal surgery without participant outcomes.
concise_private_rationale: Protocol without participant outcome results.

evidence_supporting_decision: Patients receiving TEAS or sham after knee arthroplasty were divided according to treatment methods; random allocation is not reported.

title: [Mechanism of electroacupuncture at "Zusanli" (ST36) in improving cardiac function in mice with chronic heart failure].
evidence_supporting_decision: The experiment is conducted in mice.

title: Electroacupuncture Protocol for Sensory and Motor Function Recovery After Orthognathic Surgery: a Randomized Clinical Trial.
evidence_supporting_decision: The title identifies an orthognathic-surgery protocol and the abstract describes future study procedures without results.
